title: Basic Notes — External Media
summary: A commit-pinned external image, audio clip, and video embedded with ordinary WikiText.
text:
! External media

These three examples require a network connection. Each URL points to the same generated media as the local examples and is pinned to a specific commit of this repository instead of a moving branch. When the collection is converted together, Obsidian uses small HTML audio and video players that stream from these URLs.

!! External image

[img alt="Generated field workstation photograph"[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucasbordeau/obsidian-tiddlywiki/ec3298c8bc93773cfd6895f57f16390a12cc0b01/manual-test/tiddlywiki/media/basic-notes-field-station.jpg]]

''Caption:'' A network-backed image embedded directly with image WikiText.

!! External audio

{{Basic Notes Remote Signal.mp3}}

''Caption:'' A network-backed MP3 exposed through a typed canonical-media tiddler.

!! External video

{{Basic Notes Remote Station.mp4}}

''Caption:'' A network-backed MP4 exposed through a typed canonical-media tiddler.

Compare these network-dependent examples with the self-contained attachments in [[Basic Notes — Media]].

title: Basic Notes — Formatting
summary: Headings, inline emphasis, punctuation, and a horizontal rule.
text:
! Formatting

This paragraph combines ''bold'', //emphasis//, __underline__, ~~strikethrough~~, @@highlight@@, and a `literal code span`.

!! Nested inline formatting

''Bold outer text can contain //nested emphasis//, __an underlined detail__, @@a highlighted phrase@@, and a `code span` in the same sentence.''

!! Scientific notation

Water is H,,2,,O, while a square can be written as x^^2^^. Entities remain ordinary source: © é 💡.

!! Quote with nested formatted lists

<<<
''Inspection plan'' combines a quotation with several list levels.

* ''First pass'' opens [[Project Cedar]].
** //Second level// checks the __owner__ and @@status@@ fields.
*** The ''third level'' compares `priority` with H,,2,,O and x^^2^^.
* ''Second pass'' follows [[Cedar Planning Meeting]].
*# //Ordered detail// checks [[the reusable summary|Basic Notes — Reusable Summary]].
*#* ~~Retired wording~~ sits beside ''its active replacement''.
<<<

---

The rule separates the examples from this final paragraph, which links back to [[the starting note|Basic Notes — Start]].

title: Basic Notes — Links
summary: Pretty internal links, external links, and a plain URL.
text:
! Links

An ordinary internal link can show a different label: [[open the project|Project Cedar]].

An explicit external link can point to a stable reserved example page: [ext[example reference|https://example.org/]].

A plain URL is also recognized: https://example.org/path?source=basic-demo.

Continue to [[whole-note transclusion|Basic Notes — Transclusion]].

title: Basic Notes — Lists
summary: Unordered, ordered, and mixed lists with shallow nesting.
text:
! Lists with useful content

!! Field checklist

* Read [[Project Cedar]].
** Confirm the //owner// and ''status'' fields.
** Open [[Cedar Planning Meeting]] for decisions.
* Review [[the media note|Basic Notes — Media]].

!! Review procedure

# Open [[Basic Notes — Formatting]].
## Compare the heading levels.
## Inspect the `inline code` example.
# Open [[Basic Notes — Transclusion]].
## Follow the nested summary.

!! Mixed route

* Content
*# Start with [[links|Basic Notes — Links]].
*#* Then return to this checklist.
*## Finish with [[local media|Basic Notes — Media]].

title: Basic Notes — Start
summary: A short route through ordinary, import-oriented note features.
text:
! Basic import fixture

This self-contained wiki uses the stock interface and ordinary WikiText. The notes combine common features without custom HTML or dynamic user-interface code.

!! Suggested route

# [[Formatting|Basic Notes — Formatting]]
# [[Lists|Basic Notes — Lists]]
# [[Table, quote, and code|Basic Notes — Table, Quote, and Code]]
# [[Links|Basic Notes — Links]]
# Metadata network
#* [[Project Cedar]]
#** [[Mara Voss]]
#** [[Cedar Planning Meeting]]
# [[Whole-note transclusion|Basic Notes — Transclusion]]
#* [[Nested summary|Basic Notes — Nested Summary]]
# [[Local media|Basic Notes — Media]]
# [[External media|Basic Notes — External Media]]

The route deliberately stays small enough that every imported note can be inspected by hand.

title: Basic Notes — Table, Quote, and Code
summary: A rectangular table, a block quote, and a fenced code example.
text:
! Table

|!Note|!Role|!Next link|
|[[Project Cedar]]|''Project'' record|[[Mara Voss]]|
|[[Mara Voss]]|//Person// record|[[Cedar Planning Meeting]]|
|[[Cedar Planning Meeting]]|Meeting record|[[Basic Notes — Transclusion]]|

! Quote

<<<
Keep the fixture small enough that every relationship can be checked by hand.

The decision is recorded in [[Cedar Planning Meeting]].
<<<

! Code

The launcher is an ordinary shell command:

```sh
npm run demo:tw
```

After it opens, follow [[the suggested route|Basic Notes — Start]].

title: Basic Notes — Transclusion
text:
! Whole-note transclusion

The next block embeds [[Basic Notes — Reusable Summary]] directly.

{{Basic Notes — Reusable Summary}}

!! Shallow nested transclusion

The next block embeds [[Basic Notes — Nested Summary]], which embeds the same reusable summary once more.

{{Basic Notes — Nested Summary}}

No template, filter, field reference, widget, or macro is involved.
